docs.summary: Migrates a live scene onto recompiled user types with the [`ReloadEngine`](#api~Prowl.Ember.ReloadEngine): the engine, the editor and the scene are all in scope, so the walk migrates the whole graph in place (component fields, identity, and delegates to user methods all carry over), then [`OnHotReload`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Scene) re-derives per-frame membership from the new types. Both assemblies stay loaded, no unload required.
